summary: BackgroundMusic (export K) instantiates the BgmPlayer class from module 58572 (aliased GryphlineWebSDK) with static/media/sound/bgm.3ce37f.mp3, loop, autoPlay, fade, suspendWhenHidden and suspendWhenHiddenInSkland all enabled, and volume 0.1 on mobile user agents (DeviceUtils.Fr) or 1 otherwise. On the server it is a stub exposing no-op enable() and disable().
